bias.en: Downtrend · reversed from $167, slipped under the 200-day
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 自 $167 回落，跌破 200 日均线

read.en: Palantir fell 1.9% on Nov 19 to $153.68, trading $153.20–167.13, its lowest close since Aug 3. It is below the 5-day ($159.1) and 10-day ($163.8), both falling, the rising 100-day ($168.4) and the falling 30-day ($183.0), and just under the rising 200-day ($153.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($174.12), and RSI is 31.3.
read.zh: Palantir 11月19日下跌 1.9%，收于 $153.68，盘中区间 $153.20–167.13，为 8月3日以来最低收盘。股价位于下行的 5 日（$159.1）和 10 日均线（$163.8）、上行的 100 日均线（$168.4）及下行的 30 日均线（$183.0）下方，略低于上行的 200 日均线（$153.9）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图平稳；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$174.12），RSI 为 31.3。

read.en: The $167.13 high reached the 10-day area but reversed, and the close slipped under the $153.7 support (200-day, Nov 17–18 lows), now resistance; the Nov 5 low ($152.60) held. Resistance is $153.9–156.7 (200-day, Nov 17–18 closes), then $158.4–159.1 and $160.4–163.8. Support is $152.6–152.7, then $150 and $143.3 (Aug 4 low). A close above $156.7 would target $158–159; below $152.6, $150.

r.en: 200-day average $153.9, lost; Nov 17 close $156.56; Nov 18 close $156.67

s.en: Aug 4 low $143.28, base of the August gap
